meta.purpose: Determine whether the user's 2020 B3 medal corresponds to a completed B3 in 2019, 2020, or 2021.
meta.policy: Treat photos, official participant/result records, user confirmation, exact-date Strava GPS, and event calendars as separate evidence layers. Registration or possession of a mailed medal is not treated as a race finish without completion evidence.

conclusion.bestCurrentConclusion: The user did not complete the 2020 B3 races. The 2020 Sole of the City 10K and Charles Street 12 participant records reflect virtual registrations with medals sent, but the supplied RunSignup records contain no finish time or pace and the user explicitly confirmed the races were not run. The 2019 Charles Street 12 is a verified finish.
conclusion.confidence: confirmed by user + official participant screenshots

shamrock5k.note: A same-day Baltimore run exists, but its GPS is a compact Fells Point/Canton-area loop rather than a convincing match to the in-person Shamrock course.

soleOfTheCity10k.note: No Strava run exists on the official race date.

charlesStreet12.evidence: User finish-line/medal photo dated Aug. 31, 2019; user-supplied RunSignup individual result screenshot; exact-date point-to-point Strava GPS from Towson to Baltimore.
charlesStreet12.note: Official race distance is 12 miles. The supplied RunSignup screenshot confirms the participant and bib but does not expose the official finish time.

2019.seriesAssessment: Verified Charles Street 12 only; not a full 2019 B3.

soleOfTheCity10k.evidence: User-supplied RunSignup screenshot shows Alex Ford, age 32, Baltimore, MD, bib 212, but chip time, gun time, and pace are blank. User confirms the race was not run.
soleOfTheCity10k.note: A May 30, 2020 10.04 km Baltimore Strava run had previously been considered as a possible virtual completion. It is now rejected as the race based on the user's direct confirmation and blank official result record.

charlesStreet12.evidence: User-supplied RunSignup screenshot shows Alex Ford, age 32, Baltimore, MD, digital bib 60, but chip time, gun time, and pace are blank. User confirms the race was not run.
charlesStreet12.note: The 2020 Charles Street 12 medal was received but does not represent a completed race.

2020.seriesAssessment: No completed 2020 B3. Medal/registration evidence must not be displayed as race finishes.

shamrock5k.note: Exact-deadline 5K in Baltimore, but no evidence currently ties it to the B3 series.
